description: List elements exposed by the app React-fiber inspection integration, with available names, text, roles, testIDs, positions and native tags. This is not a complete native accessibility tree or a visual screenshot. Use the returned controls to select a target for tap_element; refresh after navigation or state changes. Empty results can reflect unavailable inspection. Needs the highlight-updates interaction integration. Works on the free tier.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeBuoy.description: Also list Buoy's own overlay — the dial, tool sheets, Ask Buoy's chat. Default false: the screen described is the app's. Exact testIDs inside Buoy (buoy-…) can still be tapped without this.

includeHidden.description: Also list screens that are mounted but not showing (other tabs, screens under the current one). Default false: only what is on screen.

interactiveOnly.description: Only return tappable (onPress) elements. Default false (include labels/text for context).

name: describe_screen
